title: WorkerDeck agent settings
description: Saved to the gateway on save. A removed key goes back to its default. Changes apply when the agent next starts or wakes.

cwd.description: The project directory the agent's sessions run in.

profile.description: The gateway profile (engine and account) the agent runs on.

model.description: The model id; absent means the profile's default.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort for the model; absent means the profile's default.

permissionMode.description: The permission mode a new session starts in.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Load instruction files (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/rules`) from the project folder and every folder above it, as the engine does on its own.
Load instruction files only from the project folder and below. Your own `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` and `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` still load. For team members in a monorepo sub-folder.
instructionScope.description: Which instruction files the agent's sessions load.

agentContextReset.description: Whether the agent may start a fresh conversation itself with the context_reset tool.

sleepAfterMs.description: Idle time in milliseconds before the agent's engine sleeps; 0 never sleeps. Absent means the gateway default.
